frameReview.method: Inspected 24 current portable/shared/native frames in six labeled contact sheets, four full-resolution native baseline details and current five-model overview. Geometry supported and center/west gap open. Existing aerial inspected at natural size; the north/east latrine is partly obscured and roof/preservation state remains unresolved. One shared detail view clips the far rim; other views cover the full ring. Flat planes are unsuitable for native wall-base grade judgments. Original path rendering leaves a sliver crossing the inner wall in a close view; no road source was changed.
